_help: Wuthering Waves banner schedule for the 'Coming up' card. Add each new phase when Kuro announces it.
start: a time with an offset (+08:00) is one global moment, e.g. a version update after maintenance.
A time without an offset is server time (Phase 2 banners open at 10:00 on each server's own clock).
tentative: true marks leaked or predicted dates and characters (shown with a '?').
When every listed phase has started, the card guesses the next one phaseDays after the last start.
